text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor m-e-r-g-e-d the t-e-n-d-e-r f-i-l-e-s into a s-h-a-r-e-d w-o-r-k-s-p-a-c-e and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-e c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) they f-o-r-m-u-l-a-t-e-d the c-o-v-e-r b-i-d-s with a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e and l-e-f-t a c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r of w-i-n-n-i-n-g b-i-d-d-e-r-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-a-l-i-d-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
3) the actor d-i-s-c-l-o-s-e-d the h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n t-h-r-o-u-g-h c-l-a-i-m n-u-m-b-e-r-s and l-e-f-t a f-i-l-e of p-a-y-m-e-n-t r-e-c-o-r-d-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l r-e-v-i-e-w
4) they e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n via e-m-a-i-l and l-e-f-t a c-o-p-y of the c-o-r-r-e-s-p-o-n-d-e-n-c-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the n-e-e-d-t-o-k-n-o-w r-e-s-t-r-i-c-t-i-o-n
5) the actor s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e-d the p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t p-r-o-c-e-s-s to a-p-p-e-a-r c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e and l-e-f-t a r-e-p-o-r-t of m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e b-i-d-d-e-r-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-o-n-t-r-o-l
